description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewala, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530226
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership and land title settlements, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
